description.zh: 修改实时日志投递的域名，仅支持修改单个。
description.en: The accelerated domain name for which you want to update real-time log delivery. Only one domain name is supported.
The name of the Logstore where log entries are stored.
The name of the Log Service project that is used for real-time log delivery.

description.zh: 实时投递sls的地域，详情请参见[实时日志服务推送地域](~~144883~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Log Service project is deployed. For more information, see [Regions that support real-time log delivery](~~144883~~).

descriptions.en: > Each account can call this operation up to 100 times per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn modify-realtime-log-delivery --project testProject --logstore TestLog --biz-region ch-shanghai --domain example.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn ModifyRealtimeLogDelivery --region cn-hangzhou --Project testProject --Logstore TestLog --Region 'ch-shanghai' --Domain 'example.com'
